factorial_exposure_match.scope: Initial endpoints only; identical sample counts and total unpadded input tokens, not identical model FLOPs or elapsed time.

initial_source_audit.scope: The initial library/model/data/optimizer/sampler/training implementation remains byte-identical. The CLI entrypoint adds reporting and separately frozen conditional-phase dispatch; its original snapshot remains archived.

scope: Completed controlled screens and their separately registered extensions. All successful trace lines count, including probes and replay. Development is observed; controlled-only results do not establish a factual release. Memory samples are not continuous peaks.

extension-selection.scope: Both 512-world capacities extend together if either is still learning by the preregistered criterion; initial factorial remains a fixed-visit comparison.

selection.scope: A known-mastery-qualified controlled curriculum may proceed to separately frozen natural/unknown supervision. This selection is not a factual release or full-recipe confirmation.

supervised-selection.scope: All permitted primary recipes are terminal. Eligible joint profile is preferred, otherwise eligible binary. A negative selection skips confirmation/calibration/acceptance; a positive selection still requires the same full recipe at seed 2027.

retained-selection.scope: A positive corrected recipe still requires full own-parent second-seed confirmation before calibration/acceptance. A negative selection closes this finite corrective branch.

base-32-1337.stop_reason: Known retention failed by the fixed 500-update supervised ceiling
base-32-1337.scope: Observed development only; no calibration or acceptance result.

retained-base-32-1337.scope: Explicit corrective fork. Recipe step/exposure totals include 500 inherited updates; actual_new_trace_updates and global ledger count only newly executed updates. No acceptance opened.

train.reviewer_scope: Codex assistant, one target-blind review; not independent human or second-model agreement. Source disagreements remain excluded, not automatically relabelled. Review happens before supervised recipe selection.

development.reviewer_scope: Codex assistant, one target-blind review; not independent human or second-model agreement. Source disagreements remain excluded, not automatically relabelled. Review happens before supervised recipe selection.

natural_inventory_interpretation.correction: The quota_limitation wording about only 56 fresh Chinese contradiction materials describes the first-encountered-candidate-per-record inventory, not exhaustive availability of other hypotheses in the cached source. Deduplication precedes length filtering and can discard additional same-record hypotheses. No samples, source-label agreements, review decisions or model gates change.
natural_inventory_interpretation.scope: Provenance interpretation before supervised training; original reservation and its hashes remain unchanged.

base.scope: Observed novel-actor binary development only. CPU inference, independent grouping without contrast IDs, agreement with recorded CUDA metrics, independent gold/render integrity and public reversed-candidate ID checks. No optimizer updates.

full-row-verification.scope: Independent direct row counts agree with the existing evaluator for each full novel-actor binary panel.

input-pipeline.scope: Actual own-parent NativeBpe plus experimental collator/caps; compare complete state and every question-option token sequence. Read-only, no optimizer or model inference.

large.scope: Observed novel-actor binary development only. CPU inference, independent grouping without contrast IDs, agreement with recorded CUDA metrics, independent gold/render integrity and public reversed-candidate ID checks. No optimizer updates.

development_policy_assessment.scope: Retrospective gate assessment only; no optimizer updates or counterfactual model outcomes. Original protocols, trajectories, selections and release criteria remain historical evidence. Direction is assessed from held-out trends separately from release eligibility.
